Synopsis:
    Fed Governor Waller signaled a preference to hold rates steady at the upcoming September meeting, triggering a stock rally and bond yield decline. However, the decision remains a near coin-flip, with August CPI acting as the potential swing factor. Meanwhile, the yen surged 2% without intervention, on strong BOJ rate hike bets. Nvidia announced a $13B acquisition of Hugging Face, extending its AI ecosystem reach amid circular financing concerns. A broader theme covers how the US Treasury market's ownership base has shifted from stable sovereign holders (China) to more leveraged, volatile fast-money investors.
